title: container image-staleness: preflight hot-loops with no backoff, false-stale on Dockerfile touch, ensure-up does not auto-rebuild
description: Three related defects in container worker-isolation staleness, all hit on CAM-98 (2026-07-06) when cam-worker:latest was older than the Dockerfile. (1) The per-dispatch container-preflight (image-stale) retries ~9/s with no backoff, hot-looping until the image is fresh (contrast the implement/review backoff). (2) False-stale: the check compares Dockerfile mtime vs image Created; a Dockerfile touched without content change stays permanently stale, and a normal rebuild is a full cache hit that never updates Created, so only docker build --no-cache clears it. Consider hashing Dockerfile content instead of mtime. (3) ensure-up did not auto-rebuild the stale image at supervisor boot despite CAM-152 specifying image-stale to rebuild+recreate; the dispatch path fail-closed instead of triggering the rebuild. Recovery this session was a manual docker build --no-cache.
